default.notes: Apply through an Equatoguinean embassy before travel — historically one of the hardest tourist visas to obtain. An official eVisa introduced in 2024 is easing access; confirm the current channel with the embassy.

groups.notes: CEMAC citizens enter Equatorial Guinea visa-free under the Community's free-movement arrangements — a valid passport or CEMAC travel document suffices for short stays.

US citizens enter visa-free for short stays under a rare bilateral arrangement — commonly cited as up to 90 days; carry an onward ticket and a yellow fever certificate if arriving from a risk country.

GQ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Equatoguinean citizens.
